0384.name: IacCoolantAdder

03C0.name: FlexCoolantWeight

03CC.name: RpmFilterAboveIdle

03D8.name: PurgeMonitorLimit
03D8.desc: Purge monitor (PurgeMonFlags bit 7): value PurgeMonitorValue against the purge command, at least $774F

0429.name: BaroUpdateMapOffset
0429.desc: Barometric pressure update while running: offset added to MAP against engine rpm (throttle above $04C1)

046B.name: AcThrottleUpper
046B.desc: A/C throttle logic (AcCutControl), ControlFlags943 bit 7 clear: throttle at or above this value against vehicle speed sets bit 7

0477.name: AcThrottleLower

0483.name: AcThrottleUpperSet
0483.desc: ControlFlags943 bit 7 set: throttle at or above this value against vehicle speed keeps bit 7

048F.name: AcThrottleLowerSet
048F.desc: ControlFlags943 bit 7 set: throttle below this value keeps bit 7; otherwise bit 7 clears after the delay $04EE/$04EF (AcCutTimer)

04A1.name: BattTempSoakLimit

04AD.name: BattTempSoakAdder
04AD.desc: Battery temperature model at start: addition to BattTempModelValue against the engine-off time

04C6.name: BattTempHeatFactor
04C6.desc: Battery temperature model: factor on the excess above 110 against coolant (engine heat), into BattTempStored

0507.name: FanAcDelaySpeed

051E.name: FanPwmStepCoolant
051E.desc: PWM fan (FanPwmCoolantPid): duty change against the coolant PD term (FanPwmStepCoolantValue, error to $05A2/$05A3 and rate)

0537.name: FanPwmStepAc
0537.desc: PWM fan (FanPwmControl): duty change against the A/C sensor PD term (FanPwmStepAcValue) with A/C requested

054B.name: FanPwmStepBusTemp
054B.desc: PWM fan (FanPwmBusPid): duty change against the PD term of the bus temperature BusTemp (received on the serial bus) (FanPwmStepBusValue)

057D.name: ResetCoolantInit
057D.desc: At reset: IdleRpmRefStart against start coolant temperature

059A.name: EgrThrottleMax
059A.desc: EGR enable: throttle limit against vehicle speed while EGR is on

05AC.name: EgrThrottleMaxOff
05AC.desc: As EgrThrottleMax while EGR is off (hysteresis)

05BE.name: EgrMapMinRpm
05BE.desc: EGR enable: MAP must be above this value against engine rpm (plus $0623 while off)

05E2.name: EgrStartDelayCoolant
05E2.desc: EGR delay after start (EgrStartDelay) against start coolant temperature

0609.name: EgrFlowFilterVacuum
0609.desc: EGR flow estimate: filter weight against manifold vacuum (multiplied by rpm)

0615.name: EgrFeedForward
0615.desc: EGR valve: base PWM duty against the position target, added to the PID terms (output to PWMA)

062B.name: EgrPressureRatio
062B.desc: EGR flow estimate: factor against the ratio ($0684 − MAP)/(baro − MAP), into EgrPressureFactor

0637.name: EgrTarget
0637.desc: EGR valve position target (EgrTargetPos) against part-throttle MAP position (rows) and engine rpm (columns); EGR off below $035E

07D8.name: FlexLearnInit
07D8.desc: Flex-fuel learning: start value FlexLearnBase against the ethanol value FlexEthanolStart

07E4.name: FlexLearnPurgeFactor
07E4.desc: Flex-fuel learning: factor FlexLearnPurgeValue against the purge ramp PurgeRamp

07F8.name: FlexLearnTimeGain2
07F8.desc: Flex-fuel learning: second gain FlexLearnGain2 against the learning time

0804.name: FlexLearnTimeGain
0804.desc: Flex-fuel learning: gain FlexLearnGain against the learning time (FlexLearnFuelSum / 2, at most 255)

0810.name: FlexLearnStartCoolant
0810.desc: Flex-fuel learning: value FlexLearnStartCoolantValue against start coolant temperature

081C.name: FlexLearnEthanolCurve
081C.desc: Flex-fuel learning: curve from FlexLearnLevel1/FlexLearnLevel2 to FlexLearnEthanol1/FlexLearnEthanol2

0828.name: FlexLearnLevelFactor
0828.desc: Flex-fuel learning: value FlexLearnLevelValue against FuelLevelScaled (probably fuel level)

083C.name: FlexLearnTrimWeight
083C.desc: Flex-fuel learning: weight FlexLearnTrimWeightValue against the size of the short-term trim

0848.name: FlexLearnLimitPurgeTrim2
0848.desc: Flex-fuel learning: limit FlexEthanolLimit against PurgeCellTrim2, compared with FlexLearnBase

0860.name: CrankEthanolScale
0860.desc: Cranking: flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of CrankEthanolCoolant

086C.name: PartThrottleMapScale
086C.desc: MAP to row position of the part-throttle spark and fuel tables

0878.name: WotMapScale
0878.desc: MAP to row position of the WOT spark and fuel tables

0884.name: FlexEthanolScale
0884.desc: Flex-fuel: ethanol content (FlexEthanol) to the scaled value FlexEthanolScaled used as table input

0890.name: RpmCurveV0C4A
0890.desc: Engine rpm (high byte) to RpmCurveValue; all points 255 in the reference image

089C.name: DecelMapScale
089C.desc: Corrected MAP to row position of DecelMapRpmLimit

08A8.name: AfterStartTimeScale
08A8.desc: Time since start (TimeSinceStart, counted every 32 main-loop passes) to row position of AfterStartDecay

08BC.name: WarmupMapScaleLowSpeed
08BC.desc: MAP to row position of WarmupMapCoolantLowSpeed

08C8.name: WarmupMapScale
08C8.desc: MAP to row position of WarmupMapCoolant

08D4.name: WarmupRpmScaleIdle
08D4.desc: Rpm to row position of WarmupRpmCoolantIdle

08E0.name: IdleEnrichEthanolScale
08E0.desc: Flex-fuel ethanol content to row position of IdleEnrichEthanolAirTemp

08EC.name: TipInThrottleIndex
08EC.desc: Tip-in enrichment: throttle opening to row index 1-9 of TipInMatrix

0900.name: TipInRateIndex
0900.desc: Tip-in enrichment: throttle opening step to column index 1-9 of TipInMatrix

0914.name: DecelLeanRpmScale
0914.desc: Deceleration enleanment: rpm to row position of DecelLeanAirflow

0920.name: DecelLeanThrottleScale
0920.desc: Deceleration enleanment: throttle opening to column position of DecelLeanAirflow

092C.name: DecelLeanTimeScale
092C.desc: Deceleration enleanment: time since start to row position of DecelLeanTimeCoolant

0938.name: IacFuelScale
0938.desc: Extra idle air (IacTargetCmd minus IacPosition) to row position of IacFuelCoolant

0944.name: PurgeFuelMapScale
0944.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: MAP to row position of PurgeFuelBase

094E.name: PurgeFuelRpm
094E.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction: engine rpm to column position of PurgeFuelBase

0958.name: CoolantSparkMapScale
0958.desc: MAP to row position of CoolantSparkMap

0964.name: AirTempSparkMapScale
0964.desc: MAP to row position of AirTempSparkMapRpm

0970.name: AfterStartSparkMapScale
0970.desc: MAP to row position of AfterStartSparkMapRpm

097C.name: SurgeMapScale
097C.desc: Driveline surge spark control (SurgeControl): MAP to row position (Scratch6, SurgeMapPos)

0988.name: SurgeDecayGearScale
0988.desc: Driveline surge spark control: rpm/speed ratio (gear) to row position of SurgeDecay

0994.name: KnockRetardMapScale
0994.desc: MAP to row position of KnockRetardLimit

09A0.name: IdleBattTempScale
09A0.desc: Battery temperature to row position of IdleBattTempTarget

09AC.name: IacRollThrottleScale
09AC.desc: IAC target while rolling: throttle opening to row position of IacRollThrottleRpm

09B8.name: IacCoastSpeedScale
09B8.desc: Vehicle speed to row position of IacCoastSpeedRpm

09C4.name: IacFieldDutyScale
09C4.desc: Filtered duty of the CS2 input $106E.5 (probably the generator field) to row position of IacFieldDutyRpm

09D0.name: IacBaroScale
09D0.desc: Barometric pressure to row position of IacBaseBaroTarget and IdleMapBase

09DC.name: ColdSoakMapScale
09DC.desc: MAP to row position of ColdSoakMapCoolant

09F9.name: CrankPulseCoolantFactor
09F9.desc: Factor on the cranking pulse against the cranking coolant, result into CrankPulseCoolant

0A05.desc: Cranking base pulse width: ethanol content (FlexEthanolScaled, rows) x cranking coolant temperature (columns); squared, then reduced by the decay factors below; into CrankPulse

0A62.name: CrankRpmDecay
0A62.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm, throttle not closed; weighted by CrankRpmDecayWeight

0A6C.name: CrankRpmDecayClosed
0A6C.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against rpm with the throttle closed

0A76.name: CrankRpmDecayWeight
0A76.desc: Weight of the rpm reduction against the cranking coolant

0A82.name: CrankV0769Decay
0A82.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against CrankDecayIndex; weighted by CrankV0769DecayWeight

0A8E.name: CrankV0769DecayWeight
0A8E.desc: Weight of CrankV0769Decay against the cranking coolant

0A9A.name: CrankCoolantAdder2
0A9A.desc: Cranking pulse addition against the cranking coolant, used while BatteryTemp is not above the raw MAP

0AA4.name: CrankBaroDecay
0AA4.desc: Cranking pulse reduction against barometric pressure; weighted by CrankBaroDecayWeight

0AAC.name: CrankBaroDecayWeight
0AAC.desc: Weight of CrankBaroDecay against the cranking coolant

0AB4.name: CrankVacuumFactor
0AB4.desc: Cranking pulse factor against manifold vacuum

0AC0.name: CrankEthanolCoolant
0AC0.desc: Cranking: value against ethanol content and coolant into CrankEthanolFactor

0AE1.name: CrankCoolantAdder
0AE1.desc: Cranking: added to the coolant temperature against the number of crank events (CrankEvents), limited to $0B75; result is the cranking coolant CrankCoolant

0AEA.name: InjectorDeadTime
0AEA.desc: Injector dead time against battery voltage

0B12.name: ReturnlessFuelScale
0B12.desc: Global fuel multiplier of the returnless fuel system

0B52.name: HotEngineEnrich
0B52.desc: Enrichment against coolant above $0BD9 (with rpm, MAP and time above their limits), into HotEnrich; sets FuelModeFlags2 bit 1

0B60.name: InjectionModeRpmFactor
0B60.desc: Factor against rpm on the bank pulse (FuelPulseBank1 / FuelPulseBank2) during the change of injection mode in FuelEventSchedule

0B6A.name: PartThrottleFuel
0B6A.desc: Part-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0C9F.name: PartThrottleFuelMain
0C9F.desc: 17 x 17 fuel correction, MAP x rpm, used by the main-loop fuel calculation (PartThrottleFuelCalc) and by EgrControl; PartThrottleFuel is the per-event one

0DD4.name: MapBaroOffset
0DD4.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before the part-throttle MAP scale (main-loop fuel, EgrControl, diagnostics)

0DE0.name: FuelAirTempCorr
0DE0.desc: Fuel multiplier against intake air temperature (scaled by the rpm and MAP weights)

0DEE.name: FuelAirTempMapWeight
0DEE.desc: Weight of the air-temperature fuel correction against MAP

0DF6.name: FuelAirTempRpmWeight
0DF6.desc: Weight of the air-temperature fuel correction against rpm

0E08.name: DecelBaroMapOffset
0E08.desc: Added to MAP against barometric pressure before DecelMapScale

0E12.name: DecelMapRpmLimit
0E12.desc: Deceleration fuel reduction: MAP x rpm threshold; with the throttle closed, values under it ramp DecelFuelFactor (DecelFuelFactor) in

0EBF.name: FuelEventRpmAdder
0EBF.desc: Pulse width added against rpm while SparkFlags2 bit 7 is set (result x 8)

0ED6.name: WotTimeEnrichMax
0ED6.desc: Maximum of the WOT enrichment that builds up after a sustained WOT (WotTimeEnrich), against rpm

0EE0.name: WotFuel
0EE0.desc: Wide-open-throttle fuel correction on the MAP-based pulse width

0F8D.name: WarmupCoolantAdder
0F8D.desc: Warm-up enrichment against coolant, used instead of the tables while ThrottleState bit 6 is set

0F9F.name: AfterStartDecay
0F9F.desc: After-start enrichment against time since start (rows) and CrankCoolant (columns, set by the cranking code); part of the warm-up factor

0FFD.name: WarmupRpmFactor
0FFD.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against rpm

1007.name: WarmupRunTimeFactor
1007.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against engine run time (SriMileageLow) while it is short

100F.name: WarmupMapCoolantLowSpeed
100F.desc: Warm-up enrichment, MAP x coolant, used below the vehicle speed $10F8 (with hysteresis)

106D.name: WarmupRpmFactorIdle
106D.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against rpm while ThrottleState bit 7 is set

1077.name: WarmupMapCoolant
1077.desc: Warm-up enrichment, MAP x coolant (normal case)

10D7.name: WarmupIdleTimeFactor
10D7.desc: Factor on WarmupRpmCoolantIdle against ThrottleRelearnCounter (a timer cleared by the throttle code)

10DF.name: WarmupRpmCoolantIdle
10DF.desc: Warm-up enrichment, rpm x coolant, used while ThrottleState bit 7 is set; scaled by WarmupIdleTimeFactor

113C.name: WarmupBaroFactor
113C.desc: Factor on the warm-up enrichment against barometric pressure

1148.name: BaroFuel
1148.desc: Pulse width added to the fuel pulse against barometric pressure (result x 8)

1153.name: ColdSoakMapCoolant
1153.desc: Extra warm-up factor, MAP x coolant, applied when the coolant temperature at start is within $11DE of BatteryTempStart (cold-soaked engine); result also in ColdSoakMap

117E.name: IdleEnrichSoakTime
117E.desc: Idle enrichment against the engine-off time EngineOffTime, into IdleEnrichSoak

118C.name: IdleEnrichRunTime
118C.desc: Idle enrichment against run time (IdleEnrichRun); with the others into IdleEnrichFactor, which multiplies the fuel while FuelModeFlags2 bit 3 is set (low rpm and MAP)

119A.name: IdleEnrichEthanolAirTemp
119A.desc: Idle enrichment against ethanol content (rows) and intake air temperature at start (StartAirTemp)

1204.name: FlexEthanolFactor
1204.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content (FlexEthanol) into FlexFactorEthanol, multiplied into FlexFuelFactor

1210.name: FlexEthanolRpm
1210.desc: Flex-fuel: value against ethanol content (rows) and RpmCurveValue (columns, from CalcEngineRpm), both as positions, into FlexRpmValue

12AC.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor2
12AC.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content and coolant into FlexFactorCoolant2; scales AfterStartDecay

1309.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor1
1309.desc: Flex-fuel: factor against ethanol content (FlexEthanolScaled, rows) and coolant, into FlexFactorCoolant1, multiplied into FlexFuelFactor

1366.name: FlexEthanolCoolantFactor3
1366.desc: Flex-fuel: value against ethanol content and coolant into FlexFactorCoolant3

13D6.name: FlexLearnBlend
13D6.desc: Flex-fuel learning: blend weight of the new ethanol value against the learning time (FlexLearnFuelSum / 4), RefuelFlags bit 4 set

13E2.name: FlexLearnBlend2
13E2.desc: As FlexLearnBlend with RefuelFlags bit 4 clear

13EF.name: ThrottleCloseMapOffset
13EF.desc: On throttle closing: offset subtracted from MAP into MapLast against coolant

13F9.name: AccelMapCoolant2
13F9.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment term against coolant into AccelMapCoolantFactor

1405.name: AccelMapGainCoolant
1405.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment gain against coolant, plus AccelMapGainAdder, into AccelMapGain

1411.name: MapFilterRiseCoolant
1411.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast (MapFilterCoef) while MAP rises, against coolant at start; with PurgeLoad not zero, MapFilterRisePurgeLoad is subtracted (result at least 1)

141D.name: AccelMapBaro
141D.desc: MAP-rate acceleration enrichment term against barometric pressure into AccelMapBaroFactor

142A.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment: the throttle step above $14B5 is limited to this value, against coolant

1436.name: AccelTpsCoolantFactor
1436.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment: amount per throttle step against coolant; product into AccelTpsFuel

1442.name: TpsFilterRiseCoolant
1442.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle opens, against coolant at start

144E.name: AccelTpsBaro
144E.desc: Throttle-rate acceleration enrichment term against barometric pressure into AccelTpsBaroFactor

1466.name: AccelRpmFactor
1466.desc: Acceleration enrichment factor against rpm; plus AccelMapAdder, limited to 1.0, into AccelFactor

1474.name: ResetCoolantFuelInit
1474.desc: At reset: ResetCoolantFuel (cranking fuel set-up) against coolant

148B.name: TipInAirTempFactor
148B.desc: Tip-in enrichment factor against intake air temperature

1495.name: TipInBaroFactor
1495.desc: Tip-in enrichment factor against barometric pressure; result (with ReturnlessFuelScale) into TipInFuel and spread over the next injectors

1500.name: DecelLeanThrottleCoolantFactor
1500.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the throttle-closing term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanThrottleFactor

1512.name: DecelLeanMapCoolantFactor
1512.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor on the MAP-drop term against coolant at start, into DecelLeanMapFactor

1524.name: MapFilterFallCoolant
1524.desc: Filter coefficient for MapLast (MapFilterCoef) while MAP falls, against coolant at start

152C.name: TpsFilterFallCoolant
152C.desc: Filter coefficient for ThrottleLast (TpsFilterCoef) while the throttle closes, against coolant at start

1534.name: ResetCoolantInit2
1534.desc: At reset: ResetCoolant2 against coolant temperature

153E.name: DecelLeanBaroFactor
153E.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against barometric pressure; the result, limited by $158A, is DecelLeanFuel

154A.name: DecelLeanMapAdder
154A.desc: Deceleration enleanment: added to DecelLeanRpmFactor against MAP

155E.name: DecelLeanRpmFactor
155E.desc: Deceleration enleanment: factor against rpm (with DecelLeanMapAdder)

1572.name: DecelLeanAirflow
1572.desc: Deceleration enleanment: airflow value against rpm and throttle position; the drop between last and current throttle goes to DecelLeanAir

1612.name: DecelLeanTimeCoolant
1612.desc: Deceleration enleanment shortly after start: time x coolant at start, into DecelLeanTimeFactor

166F.name: IacFuelCoolantLimit
166F.desc: Above this (against coolant) the extra idle air (IacTargetCmd minus IacPosition) sets FuelModeFlags bit 7 instead of adding fuel

1679.name: EventFuelCoolantSub
1679.desc: Per-event fuel: amount subtracted from FuelPulseAdder against coolant while FuelModeFlags bit 7 is set

1683.name: IacFuelCoolant
1683.desc: Fuel pulse added for extra idle air, rows by IacFuelScale, columns coolant; x 16 into FuelPulseAdder

16C0.name: O2StartDelayCoolant
16C0.desc: Closed-loop entry (O2StartDelays): delay against coolant (plus $323D with an O2 fault flag)

1703.name: O2PurgeLimit
1703.desc: Closed loop: limit of O2PurgeCount against the purge ramp PurgeRamp

1726.name: O2VoltageScale
1726.desc: Upstream O2 sensor ADC counts to the value used by closed loop and its monitor

1736.name: O2VoltageScale2
1736.desc: Second copy of the O2 voltage scale (same values as O2VoltageScale)

1873.name: O2StepScale
1873.desc: Closed loop: trim step against the size of the O2 error Scratch3 (doubled while purge is active and duty is zero)

187F.name: TrimUpperLimitRpm
187F.desc: Upper limit of the short-term fuel trim against rpm (signed)

188B.name: TrimLowerLimitRpm
188B.desc: Lower limit of the short-term fuel trim against rpm (signed)

1898.name: FuelTrimAdjust
1898.desc: Signed fuel adjustment (centred on 128) from calibration $1923 or, with ControlFlagsC33 bit 4 clear, from FuelTrimAdjustValue (set over the SCI line); enabled by calibration bit Options032C bit 7

18A2.name: FuelTrimAdjustMapWeight
18A2.desc: Weight of FuelTrimAdjust against MAP; the product goes to FlexStartFuel and multiplies the fuel

18C6.name: DecelCutMapThreshold
18C6.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: MAP threshold against rpm; while MAP is under it the decel timer DecelTimer counts up

18D0.name: DecelCutDelay
18D0.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: decel timer value (DecelTimer) needed against rpm

18ED.name: DecelCutMinRpmCoolant2
18ED.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against coolant (variant with ControlFlags943 bit 0 clear)

18F9.name: DecelCutMinRpmCoolant
18F9.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against coolant (variant with ControlFlags943 bit 0 set); the higher of this and DecelCutMinRpmFieldDuty applies

1905.name: DecelCutMinRpmFieldDuty2
1905.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against FieldDuty (variant with ControlFlags943 bit 0 clear)

1911.name: DecelCutMinRpmFieldDuty
1911.desc: Deceleration fuel cut-off: minimum rpm against FieldDuty (variant with ControlFlags943 bit 0 set)

1942.name: DecelCutRpmFactor
1942.desc: Factor on the fuel pulse while the deceleration cut-off flag (FuelModeFlags2 bit 7) is set, against rpm above the idle target

19C3.name: PurgeFlowScale
19C3.desc: Purge command (or constant $3048) to row position of PurgeFlow

19D7.name: PurgeCommandBase
19D7.desc: Purge command base against the purge ramp PurgeRamp, into Scratch0 (then scaled by learning and vacuum, into PurgeCommand)

19E3.name: PurgeCommandVacuum
19E3.desc: Factor on the purge command against manifold vacuum

19F1.name: PurgeDutyPart
19F1.desc: Purge solenoid duty (PurgeDuty) against the purge command, part throttle

1A19.name: PurgeDutyAlt
1A19.desc: As PurgeDutyPart with calibration bits Options0339 bit 2/Options0339 bit 3 (by ThrottleState bit 0)

1A2B.name: PurgeFlow
1A2B.desc: Purge flow estimate (PurgeMonFlow) against purge command position (rows) and manifold vacuum (columns)

1AB1.desc: Purge vapor learning, closed throttle: step subtracted from PurgeVaporClosed when the trim is below −$1B2D

1ABD.name: PurgeLearnUpPart

1AC9.name: PurgeLearnDownPart
1AC9.desc: Purge vapor learning, part throttle: step subtracted from PurgeVaporPart when the trim is below −$1B2D

1AD5.name: PurgeFuelBase
1AD5.desc: Purge vapor fuel correction base against MAP (rows) and rpm (columns, normalised lookup); multiplied by the learned vapor value PurgeVaporClosed

1B43.desc: Lower limit of the spark change against time since start (SparkStartTime), into Temp4FC

1B4D.name: AfterStartSparkCap
1B4D.desc: Upper limit of the spark change against time since start while SparkFlags2 bit 3 is set (coolant above $1BED, baro, RefPeriodLow window)

1CA3.desc: Spark addition with EGR active (EgrFlags bit 1): part-throttle MAP position (rows) and engine rpm (columns); scaled by EgrFlowFactor with calibration bit Options0335 bit 2

1DD8.name: CoolantSparkMap
1DD8.desc: Spark change against MAP (rows) and coolant (columns), signed

1E35.desc: Weight of AirTempSparkMapRpm against intake air temperature (or BatteryTemp with calibration bit Options0330 bit 5 clear)

1E3F.name: AirTempSparkMapRpm
1E3F.desc: Spark change for intake air temperature, MAP x rpm (signed), scaled by AirTempSparkFactor

1E7E.name: AfterStartSparkCoolant
1E7E.desc: Spark change after start against the coolant temperature at start, into AfterStartSparkStart

1EA0.name: AfterStartSparkMapRpm
1EA0.desc: Spark change after start, MAP x rpm (signed), weighted by AfterStartSparkCoolantWeight

1EFD.name: BaroSpark
1EFD.desc: Spark change against barometric pressure, weighted by BaroSparkRpmWeight

1F0D.name: DecelSpark
1F0D.desc: Spark change against the deceleration fuel factor (DecelFuelFactor), signed

1F1B.name: HighSpeedSparkRpm
1F1B.desc: Spark retard against engine rpm above coarse vehicle speed $1FA6 (hysteresis $1FA5)

1FF8.name: EventSparkThrottle

2002.desc: As EventSparkThrottle while EventSparkFlags bit 3 is set (raised by $205E per loop)

2027.name: SpeedRpmRef2
2027.desc: As SpeedRpmRef with SwitchInputs bit 0 clear

204F.name: SpeedDampP

2059.name: SpeedDampD
2059.desc: Low-speed surge spark control: spark against the change of the rpm deviation

2063.name: SpeedDampI

4A01.name: BusDataO2Mid
4A01.desc: Diagnostic bus data: O2 raw reading above this value (and not above BusDataO2High) is reported as $FF, otherwise $A0

4A04.name: O2RawHigh
4A04.desc: O2 sensor raw value at or above which the high-voltage check counts

4A05.name: O2DownHighRaw
4A05.desc: Downstream O2 circuit check: raw reading above this value counts as high (P0138/P0158)

4A06.name: O2DownHighFaultCount
4A06.desc: Downstream O2 circuit check: high counts that set the fault

4A07.name: O2DownHighPassCount
4A07.desc: Downstream O2 circuit check: high-check counts that pass the test

4A08.name: FieldVoltsStep
4A08.desc: Generator field control: voltage change beyond this value sets ChargeMonFlags bit 7

4A09.name: ChargeMonVoltsMargin
4A09.desc: Charging monitor (ChargeLowMonitor): battery voltage plus this margin below the charging target counts as undercharging

4A0A.name: ChargeMonRpmMin
4A0A.desc: Charging monitor: engine rpm at or above this value

4A0B.name: ChargeMonTime
4A0B.desc: Charging monitor: time (ChargeMonTimer) before ChargeMonFlags bit 3 sets

4A0C.name: ChargeMonClearTime
4A0C.desc: Charging monitor: time before ChargeMonFlags bit 6 clears

4A0D.name: ChargeMonFailTime
4A0D.desc: Charging monitor: time before ChargeMonFlags bit 6 (fault) sets

4A0E.name: CatTempSensorHigh
4A0E.desc: Catalyst temperature sensor (CatTempMonitor, Options0330 bit 4, input $0A8E shared with the flex sensor): reading at or above this value is a high fault (P1483)

4A0F.name: CatTempSensorLow
4A0F.desc: Catalyst temperature sensor: reading at or below this value is a low fault (P1482)

4A10.name: EgrPosSensorLow
4A10.desc: EGR position sensor below this value is a low-input fault

4A11.name: EgrPosSensorHigh
4A11.desc: EGR position sensor (EgrPosition) above this value is a high-input fault (EgrPositionMonitor)

4A12.name: EgrCircuitEdgeMargin
4A12.desc: EGR solenoid circuit check (EgrSolenoidCheck, P0403): PWM counter position within this value of an edge is not sampled

4A13.name: EgrCircuitDutyMargin
4A13.desc: EGR solenoid circuit check: margin around the commanded duty (PWMA) for the on/off sample window

4A14.name: EgrCircuitCount
4A14.desc: EGR solenoid circuit check: wrong-level counts (EgrPosition58A, reached through Y) before the fault

4A15.name: PurgeCircuitFlowMax
4A15.desc: Purge solenoid check: measured flow (PurgeFlowMeasured) at or above this value with the valve closed is a fault

4A16.name: PurgeCircuitErrorMax
4A16.desc: Purge solenoid check: flow error above this value counts as not tracking

4A17.name: PurgeCircuitErrorCount
4A17.desc: Purge solenoid check: counts (PurgeCircuitErrors) of not tracking before the fault

4A18.name: PurgeCircuitTargetMax
4A18.desc: Purge solenoid check: flow target (PurgeFlowTarget) at or below this value for the tracking check

7087.name: ChargeVoltsMin
7087.desc: Lower limit of the charging voltage target

74E5.name: VssPeriodMin
74E5.desc: Vehicle speed (CalcVehicleSpeed): with VssPulseIndex / 2 at or above this value the pulse data are stored (VssStore); below it the branch that runs every fourth main-loop pass is taken

74E6.name: PwmPeriodC18
74E6.desc: PWM period of output C18 (Options0333 bit 6): Reset stores value x 250 into PwmC18Period, which PwmC18PeriodCalc uses with the duty PwmC18Duty (in %)

74E7.name: PurgePwmPeriod
74E7.desc: Proportional purge PWM period (Options0333 bit 7): value × 250 into PurgePwmPeriodCount; the duty comes from PurgePwmDuty

74E8.name: PurgeCircuitCloseTime
74E8.desc: Purge solenoid check (PurgeSolenoidCheck, P0443, proportional purge): time (PurgeCloseTimer) after the duty drops to zero

7533.name: FieldRpmMin
7533.desc: Generator field control (FieldRampControl): engine rpm at which the field is enabled

7534.name: FieldRpmOff
7534.desc: Generator field control: engine rpm below which it is disabled again

7535.name: FieldFaultDuty
7535.desc: Generator field: value of FieldDutyLimit with a field circuit fault while running

7536.name: FieldFaultDutyCrank
7536.desc: Generator field: value of FieldDutyLimit with a field circuit fault while not running

753A.name: SciErrorCount
753A.desc: Serial receive (SciLogReceive): error count (SciErrors) at or above which reception restarts

753C.name: CamFaultClearSwitch
753C.desc: CamFaultClear: when not zero the counts CamFault18D/CamFaultCount2 are cleared every 0.19 s pass

7563.name: FuelEventOffsetInAlt
7563.desc: As FuelEventOffsetIn with calibration bit Options0338 bit 2 set

774C.name: CamFaultDelay
774C.desc: Cam sensor monitor (CamSensorMonitor, P0340): delay (CamFaultTimer, word) set after a fault report

774F.name: PurgeMonitorValueMin
774F.desc: Lower limit of PurgeMonitorValue from PurgeMonitorLimit

7750.name: PurgeMonHoldTime
7750.desc: Purge monitor: time (PurgeMonTimer) the hold state (PurgeMonFlags bit 4) lasts

ABAC.name: RpmPeriodConstant
ABAC.desc: Dividend (long, also read from $ABB1) for engine rpm from the reference period (CalcEngineRpm, CalcRpmFromPeriod)

ABB1.name: CylinderCount
ABB1.desc: Number of cylinders (4): the cylinder index CylinderIndex counts up to it and the per-event code uses it

ABB2.name: RunModeTimeWarm
ABB2.desc: Run-mode switch (RunModeSwitch): time after start (Count3s, word) with coolant at or above 15 °C before ControlFlags943 bits 3-4 are set

ABB6.name: RunModeCountRunning
ABB6.desc: Run-mode switch: count needed once the engine has run (ControlFlagsC33 bit 5) and the battery is at or above 11.0 V

ABB7.name: RunModeCount
ABB7.desc: Run-mode switch: count RunModeCounter needed (battery at or above 11.0 V, or warm)

ABB8.name: RunModeCountColdLowVolts
ABB8.desc: Run-mode switch: count needed cold with the battery below 11.0 V

ABD3.name: FuelEventCylFactor
ABD3.desc: Per-cylinder offset factor (multiplied by the cylinder index CylinderIndex)

ABE0.name: RpmRateDivisor
ABE0.desc: Divisor of the rpm rate terms (IdleRpmRate, RpmRateTerm): rpm change × segment rpm / this value (word)

3F88.name: FaultTable
3F88.desc: Fault attributes: id, trigger count, blink code, attributes, bit mask, byte offset, P-code (BCD), 2 spare bytes

713B.name: BitCollectMaps
713B.desc: Bit maps for CollectBits: 8 entries of RAM offset, mask and output bit build one status byte (switch inputs for SwitchInputsRead and SwitchBitsCollect, output and fault status bytes for the SCI and bus messages)

758C.name: FaultStatusMap
758C.desc: Fault-to-status map, 44 rows: fault table row, status byte and mask, second status byte and mask. SciDiagCommand scans all rows (FaultStatusMapRows) and sends the codes whose status bit is set. Rows 11-32 ($75FA, FaultTwoTripRows) are the two-trip tests of ObdFaultReport: the first pair is the pending byte (ObdPriorFailSwitch/ObdPriorFailO2/ObdPriorFailMisc), the second the test result the monitor sets before the call; a failure with the pending bit set reports the fault, a pass clears both

C584.name: IncSaturateList
C584.desc: Pairs of RAM counter address and limit used by EventCounters

24C2.name: KnockWindowSetup
24C2.desc: Knock chip set-up values sent by KnockChipConfig (KnockWindowInit, KnockWindowUpdate); 9 per row, probably one per window position

23A9.name: KnockRpmSteps
23A9.desc: Word list of rpm break points: KnockThresholdCalc and KnockCylinderRetard compare EngineRpm with it to pick the row of their tables

195E.name: EventCorrSequenceA
195E.desc: Byte sequence read by EventCorrections (first branch, with RAM $87A8): step data for the per-event correction

191D.name: EventCorrSequenceB
191D.desc: Byte sequence read by EventCorrections (second branch, with RAM $87A5)

03FE.name: StartPulseOffset
03FE.desc: Start injector pulse, per injector (StartInjectorPulse, index StartInjector808): signed word added to the pulse after StartPulseFactor; a negative word is subtracted, the result held within $0000-$FFFF. All 0 in 05293190AC

040A.name: StartPulseFactor
040A.desc: Start injector pulse, per injector: factor word applied by MulFractionSigned before StartPulseOffset. $8000 = x1.0, $8001-$FFFF = x1.0 to x2.0, $0001-$7FFF = x(word/65536), $0000 = pulse 0. All $8000 in 05293190AC
